title: Wide Scoop Snow Shovel
description: One original fixed snow shovel counted as one prop: a broad shallow concave blue scoop has a continuous closed 10 mm vertical-thickness shell, low side wings and a blunt front edge. Two solid rear ribs meet the back of the scoop. A hollow rear socket has a finite join with the scoop and surrounds the inserted end of a long wooden shaft. The other end enters the solid lower stem of one orange D-shaped grip with a true full-thickness opening. The tool lies horizontally with finite support at the front scoop underside and the rear grip. Six editable closed meshes and four opaque constant PBR colours; no texture, animation, person, snow pile, footprints, plinth or surrounding scene. Metres, source Z up, front -Y, origin at ground under the shaft centreline, 700 mm behind the scoop front edge. Static visual geometry only. No snow-clearing action, snow or force simulation, capacity, ergonomics, cold resistance, sharpness, physical strength, manufacture, load, durability or winter-tool safety claim. No fit with prior snow piles, porches or characters. Dimensions describe this fixed visual geometry only.
